title: MaleTheme Solo #009 · 남 피트니스 모델·골드 글리터·닌자 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a cherry-blossom avenue in full bloom with a pale paved path strewn with petals, a waist-high wooden fence, a standard park bench and lamp posts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Korean man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, luminous porcelain skin, a calm gentle gaze, sleek silver-grey hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold ship's anchor, a lead round bell, a silver cube-shaped block, a gold hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver bracelets. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black ninja headband with a polished steel plate across his forehead, black fingerless wrist wraps, and a minimal black T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him tied with a red sash at the hip, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue ballet heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
